interactions.summary: Jiang states directly that love is not passive feeling but an act of openness and generosity that turns the universe toward God and increases happiness in the world.

A student reads Dante's recovery of sight, his encounter with Adam, and Adam's self-description: he can perceive Dante's desire, and his real trespass was crossing the boundary rather than merely tasting the fruit.

Jiang says Dante has passed the test and is now probing Adam's long exile and eventual ascent to heaven, then pushes the class toward the paradox of that forgiveness while students first answer with time and lifespan observations.

claims.claim: Jiang defines love as an action of openness, generosity, and other-directed movement that turns the universe toward God and increases happiness.
In the Adam passage, the decisive issue is not simply fruit consumption but trespassing the boundary set by God.
Jiang treats Dante's meeting with Adam as evidence that Adam was eventually forgiven and allowed to ascend to heaven after exile.
Jiang frames Adam's eventual ascent as paradoxical and even heretical because it pressures standard Christian explanations of sin, punishment, and redemption.

signature_moments.moment: Love is recast as a cosmic action that literally turns the universe toward God rather than a private emotion.
signature_moments.source_phrase: you turn the universe towards God
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This is one of Jiang's strongest operational definitions of love and should survive into the public read.

signature_moments.moment: Adam's fall is shifted from eating an object to violating a boundary, changing the moral geometry of Eden.
signature_moments.source_phrase: solely in my trespass of the boundary
signature_moments.why_it_matters: This is the textual hinge for Jiang's later paradox and for his revision of who carries responsibility.

glossary_terms.definition_or_usage: Dante's formulation, emphasized by Jiang, that relocates original sin from the fruit itself to crossing a God-set limit.

uncertainty_notes.note: Jiang announces the paradox before the class has fully articulated it, so this packet mostly stages the problem rather than resolving it.
